item.title: Livermore school board stops morning meetings amid public ‘trust issues’
item.description: The LVJUSD board agreed last week to revise its regular meeting calendar for the remainder of the school year, axing all morning meetings in favor of hosting evening-only sessions for the sake of bolstering community trust.
